title: Say It Clearly: Pronunciation for Biology Words
objective: Students learn stress, syllables, and slow practice for common biology terms.
outcomes: Divide long biology words into syllables.
Notice word stress in academic words.
Practice difficult sounds in biology vocabulary.
Say model sentences slowly and clearly.
activity: Hear which part of a biology word is stressed. Say the word in a sentence.
example: The word “photosynthesis” becomes pho-to-SYN-the-sis. Students practice it in the sentence: “Photosynthesis occurs in plants.”
